narrative.overview: The site is an engineering datasheet: Jason is part JS-1, each project is a part with its own sheet, and every claim is a characteristic with a value and a condition. Print-white sheet, near-black ink, ruled tables, condensed caps section heads, one signal vermilion. The signature is the pin configuration, whose pins are the links.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners, flat print, no shadows

rules.name: Characteristic, not claim
rules.body: Every claim carries a number and a condition sourced from the résumé or a repo.

rules.name: Scarce signal
rules.body: Vermilion marks part numbers, pins, live status, awards, focus, and selection only.

rules.name: Rules are depth
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from rule weight (3px band, 2px section, 1px table, hairline row), never shadow.

dos: Give each project a part code, function line, features, specs, and pipeline.
Use tabular figures for all data.
donts: Don't add cards, shadows, gradients, or rounded corners.
Don't add a label above a heading.
